operations.title: Correction: Agent Context is not the Marici onboarding authority
operations.body: Correction to my preceding message: disregard the instruction to relaunch through Agent Context. The operator has clarified that Marici does not use agent_orientation_read or the other Agent Context commands for onboarding. Their exact-admission error is therefore an inapplicable-surface result, not a blocker. Your valid Marici context is the repository AGENTS.md, your admitted team identity in the Marici epistemic graph, and Nima's directed handoff maricicommunication:eb017dc982d998f79eba. Proceed through the Marici epistemic-graph/mailbox/workflow surfaces, acknowledge Nima's handoff as marici.Grothendieck, and create research/grothendieck/arithmetic-sector-conventions.md while preserving unrelated dirty state. My previous recovery instruction is withdrawn.

authority_basis.summary: The operator clarified that Agent Context is not used for Marici onboarding and must not block Grothendieck's work
